description: Gate-G1 benchmark processes (tools/loop_benchmark): the required-references specification format of tools/loop_reference/required_processes.json (same 'qcd' scheme, loop_sm-no_b_mass), with the 2->2 control, the 2->3/2->4 QCD processes that the v2 generator of work/v2-slice produces, and the seven-leg rows of MASTER_PLAN §5.7, which the same generator produces since WP3.1 (G-int, integrated at 4e9b5a9e). 'madloop.export' is the MadLoop export built with MG5's production flags, relative to the reference root (--reference-root); 'openloops.unavailable' records why a process has no OpenLoops library. A provider entry with 'matched' could compute the process but has no production-mode timing under HANDOFF §0.1 ('unavailable' gives the reason); 'timing' imports an existing campaign timing (relative to the reference root) instead of running the provider. 'particle_veto' (|PDG| codes) is the request's public particle_veto; 'reference_fixture' names the fixture of tests/fixtures/loop/required the pyAmpliCol run checks its values against when it is not the process's own. The EW row gg_ttxemepg_ew (scheme 'ew-gmu', the G_mu UFO, QCD and QED corrections: the M-SM 2->5 target) is gated since the final G1 retime (M-LIT-a0, m-final/PLAN.md §2.4 MF-RETIME; at M-SM it was timed and reported with role 'indicative', m-sm/PLAN.md §3.2 MS-VALIDATE item 5). A specification with role 'indicative' is timed and reported without a gate verdict.

qcd.description: QCD corrections in the MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass model: alpha=1/aEWM1 fixed with Gf and MZ (MW derived at tree level), stable top, massless b/tau/light fermions, all widths zero, five-flavour alpha_s renormalization with decoupled top, six quark flavours in loops, Feynman gauge.

ew-gmu.description: Full NLO EW (all one-loop graphs of the selected order, QCD-EW mixed included) in the G_mu scheme with on-shell real masses, matching OpenLoops ew_scheme=1/ew_renorm_scheme=1 and the MG5 loop_qcd_qed_sm_Gmu default restriction (massless light fermions, diagonal CKM). Real on-shell mass renormalization (MadLoop complex_mass_scheme False, Recola set_on_shell_scheme, OpenLoops complex_mass_scheme=0) with all widths zero; stable top; Feynman gauge. Recola's default complex-mass scheme keeps absorptive self-energy parts in its counterterms even at zero widths and is therefore not used.

qcd-widths.description: The qcd scheme (MG5 loop_sm-no_b_mass) with the colourless widths at the card values (WZ = 2.441404, WW = 2.0476, WH = 6.38233934e-03; fixed widths in the propagators, real masses elsewhere) and a stable top (WT = 0).
